methodologyNotes: Covers standalone electric pet drinking fountains for cats and small-to-medium dogs sold at a published US price. Excludes non-powered gravity waterers, faucet-attached dispensers, and outdoor livestock troughs. Price is typical US MSRP in USD. capacityLiters is usable reservoir volume in liters. material is the primary water-contact construction as an enum (plastic, stainless-steel, ceramic). pumpPowerWatts is the rated pump power in watts; null if not disclosed. noiseLevelDb is the manufacturer-rated operating noise in dB(A); null if not disclosed. filterStages is the number of filtration stages as an integer count. filterLifeDays is the manufacturer-recommended filter replacement interval in days. powerSource is an enum (usb-corded, ac-adapter, wireless-battery). waterLevelWindow is a boolean for a visible external water-level indicator or window. lowWaterAlert is a boolean for a low-water LED/app alert or automatic pump shut-off. appConnectivity is a boolean for WiFi or Bluetooth app monitoring. flowModes is the number of selectable flow/stream modes as an integer count. weightGrams is the empty product weight in grams.

The Walmart listing sold by PETLIBRO's official store confirms the US price ("Current price is USD $69.99"), the "barely audible 23dB" noise rating, the 4-stage vertical filtration (1. ion-exchange resin, 2. activated carbon, 3. non-woven fabric, 4. high-density sponge), stainless-steel-tray-plus-ABS construction, and the two "Dual Water Modes" (motion-sensor induction + continuous). Amazon independently corroborates "Item model number: PLWF115," 2.5L capacity, and material "Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene (ABS), Stainless Steel" for the same cordless fountain; pumpPowerWatts and filterLifeDays were left null because no fetched page disclosed a rated pump wattage (only a 5V/1A charging-adapter output) or a filter-replacement interval in days.
